title: The Golden Cage
text: A golden birdcage hangs from a dead tree, swaying, though there is no wind. In it sits a grey bird with clever eyes. It speaks in your mother's voice, saying the things she used to say, and it knows your childhood name.

outcomes.text: It flies, singing in your mother's voice, and the song stays with you, kind.
It flies, and laughs, in a voice that is not your mother's at all.

options.label: Take the cage, bird and all.

outcomes.text: Very fine gold. The bird does not speak again, but it watches.

options.label: The wisest listens to what it says.

outcomes.text: It says something only your mother knew, and then something she never told anyone.
